rootCause.summary: Header alias collisions were treated as permanently ambiguous even when full-file value, type, grain, and sibling-column evidence left one viable semantic binding.

blockers.evidence: OrderID and OrderDate retained header-level collision alternatives after contextual evidence had ruled out the weak alternatives.
blockers.minimumValidRemediation: Resolve a header collision only when exactly one viable candidate remains and every alternative is independently contradicted, dominated, or weak without contextual support.

blockers.evidence: Resolved document identity and event time were present, but a source-wide unrelated ambiguity and a competing entity candidate prevented the document/event/atomic signature from being retained.
blockers.minimumValidRemediation: Scope ambiguity validation to selected grain dependencies, retain physical temporal evidence, and prefer an exact document semantic identity over a generic entity candidate.

blockers.evidence: Repeated/additivity blockers from unrelated measures were projected onto sales_revenue even though the bound Revenue column had atomic-row evidence.
blockers.minimumValidRemediation: Apply measure-safety blockers only to the metric's selected physical binding and preserve all unresolved binding-specific blockers.

blockers.evidence: Source-level safeToAggregate remains false because not every measure is globally safe.
blockers.minimumValidRemediation: None; metric-specific execution must remain governed and must not mutate safeToAggregate.
